label: US-UT-SB226-AIconsumer-2025 Section 3

obligations.text: (1)(a) A supplier that uses generative artificial intelligence to interact with an individual in connection with a consumer transaction shall disclose to the individual that the individual is interacting with generative artificial intelligence and not a human, if the individual asks or otherwise prompts the supplier about whether artificial intelligence is being used.
(b) The individual's prompt or question under Subsection (1)(a) must be a clear and unambiguous request to determine whether the interaction is with a human or with artificial intelligence.
